sentences.en: Chew your food well so it can be digested properly.
sentences.zh: 咀嚼食物要充分，以便能够被正确地消化。

sentences.en: Would you see to it that they get properly fed?
sentences.zh: 你会确保他们得到适当的喂养吗？

sentences.en: He doesn't have the ability to do the work properly.
sentences.zh: 他没有能力把工作做好。

senses.zh: 正确地，恰当地；适当地，得体地；完全地，彻底地
